en: Crash screen names the failed allocation and survives a full heap
Settings no longer aborts when memory is nearly gone
Wi-Fi failures say the cause and recover without a reboot
Fonts stay loaded after using the network (both devices)
The Plus gains a crash screen and fault record for the first time
Update the data packs together with this release
zh: 崩溃屏显示失败分配大小并可翻页
设置页在内存紧张时不再崩溃
Wi-Fi 失败给出具体原因并可自恢复
联网后不再卸载字体（双设备）
Plus 首次具备崩溃屏与故障记录
请与固件一并更新数据包
